PathOfBuilding.Notes:
Petrified blood for survivability - requires a good amunt of recoup to equal out - does Vitality work instead? (probably not)
How to deal with DOTs: 60% chance to avoid bleeding - currently bleed immune via flask, not ideal Ignite immune via Lori's Lantern implicit - potentially more worth with 2nd Taming or ring with Life on it, must find other way to become ignite immune in that case Poison immune via jewels + nodes on tree Other solutions: Potential via abyss jewel on stygian vise, maybe even Darkness Enthroned?
Misc to-do: - Mana regen yuge problem - Can we move power charge on critical onto a second setup to free up support gem space for stormbrand? - Figure out how on earth to level + make levelling tree
Potential (very) long term and high budget option: Move main link into archdemon crown in order to go into Shroud of the Lightless + abyss jewel stacking
Annihilating Light/Shroud version: Upsides: - triple elemental damage also affects heralds - easier to fix DOTs when we can utilise abyss jewels
- do we need Dissolution, or are there better defenses in other places? If we go no Dissolution, we can free up more life nodes on the tree for abyss jewels, but we need some other kind of defensive layer (+ we lose pain attunement) - without grace, do we stick with pure evasion bases or do we go armour/evasion? With Dissolution, always preferable to not get hit rather than take less damage so probably still evasion? - how to fix crit without Rathpith - need more ways to fit in abyss jewels, cluster jewels? - worth getting more ailment effectiveness through abyss jewels since crit chance is lower? - do we still want cold exposure if we go inverted res mastery?

Input.name: customMods
Input.string:
-- Stormy Seas -- 100% of Lightning Damage Converted to Cold Damage Your Cold Damage can Shock
-- Glacial Wave -- Enemies Chilled by your Hits lessen their Damage dealt by half of Chill Effect Enemies Chilled by your Hits have Damage taken increased by Chill Effect
-- Ghost of the Deep -- 20% increased Damage 30% increased Attack Speed 30% increased Cast Speed 30% increased Movement Speed
-- Sea Legs -- +30% to Cold and Lightning Resistances Critical Strike Chance is increased by Overcapped Lightning Resistance Evasion Rating is increased by Overcapped Cold Resistance
